# Security policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes go into the next release. Only the latest stable release and the latest beta are supported, so please update before reporting.

## Reporting a vulnerability

**Please don't open a public issue.** Report it privately through [GitHub's vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/DeFerence3/embyEx/security/advisories/new) instead.

Examples of what to report this way:

- Emby access tokens, passwords or server addresses being leaked: in logs, crash reports, files readable by other apps, or network traffic.
- A way for another app or a malicious server to make EmbyEx run code, install an update that isn't from this repository, or read or write files it shouldn't.
- Weaknesses in how updates are downloaded or verified.

Please include the affected version and platform, steps to reproduce, and what an attacker could do. You'll get a reply within a week, and you'll be credited in the advisory unless you'd rather not be.

Problems in Emby Server itself belong with [Emby](https://emby.media/community/).
